pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft to moderately sharp edge gradients. The regions show varying spatial area, appearing larger on the lower neck and shoulder transition.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of off-white pathways separating dark regions. The network exhibits primarily tri-radial junction nodes with relatively uniform pixel thickness across visible segments.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency dark fringe along the superior neck boundary, appearing as a soft-edged silhouette against the light background.
